messages:
deploy-bot: Deployment r2026.03.23 completed to canary (40%). Post-deploy smoke: embed route showed spike in 429s in eu-central-1 starting 09:12 UTC. 429 rate=2.8% (baseline <0.2%). Automated quick-check: retry-success low, p50/p95 stable. Link: https://telemetry/release/r2026.03.23
Maya R.: Seeing the 429s correlate with a burst of small batch requests from a customer shard. Could be rate shaping hitting new kernel path.
Hugo: I pulled a few request traces. Tokenization looks fine; quota-service is returning 429 for a subset. Example trace: `quota-check result=throttled user=acct-558 code=429 rule=short-burst`
infra-bot: Noted: three tokenizer pods restarted in eu-central-1 around 09:11:40Z due to image pull timeout. Restart count increased from 0 -> 3 in 30s.
Maya R.: That could cause short-term saturation on quota-worker pool if traffic rebalances. Suggest immediate mitigation: shift 100% of embed-eu traffic in eu-central-1 to fallback variant (v2026-03-22) for 10 minutes, while we stabilize nodes. Command: `deployctl switch-variant --route embed-eu --region eu-central-1 --to v2026-03-22 --duration 10m --reason "429 spike during canary"`
Hugo: +1 to traffic shift. Also recommend bumping token-cache size on quota-worker instances and scale quota-workers by +3 in eu-central.
release-manager: I'll open REL-4240 and add release notes entry: "Hotfix: temporary region pin for embed route in eu-central due to transient 429 spike during canary."
ops-bot: Issued variant switch: action_id=vs-1122, started 2026-03-23T09:15:12Z. Autoscaler action queued: scale-group=quota-workers-eu-central delta=+3 reason=canary-stability.
Hugo: After switch: subsequent synthetic samples show 429 rate down to 0.1% and p95 stable. It's looking like the restarts caused transient imbalance.
Maya R.: Good. Let's keep the switch for 10m, confirm infra stabilizes (no more restarts), then either undo switch or perform a gradual 100% rollout if stable. If restarts repeat, we rollback the canary to v2026-03-22 globally.
infra-bot: Image pull timeout was due to a misconfigured node pool pre-pull window (new hosts joined without prefetch). Fixed prefetch config and requeued image pre-pull: job=prepull-998.
ops-bot: Autoscaler completed: quota-workers-eu-central scaled +3 at 2026-03-23T09:17:02Z.
deploy-bot: Variant switch active. Current canary traffic: 40% global, embed-eu in eu-central pinned to v2026-03-22. Monitoring window extended +15m.
release-manager: REL-4240 created: https://issues/release/REL-4240. Assigning infra and platform for follow-up.
Maya R.: Thanks team. I'll post a short note in release notes draft and monitor until switch expires. :eyes:
notes: Performed region-level variant switch to fallback version and scaled quota-workers after image-pull restarts; ticket REL-4240 created for follow-up
